source_document: Windows 专项 Coding Bench 数据采购（windwos-第二版）
source_section: 5.4 交付结构; 6 Golden/no-change 对照; 7 多模型验证; 8.2 区分度准入
license: BSD-3-Clause (psutil). No psutil source code is copied into this package: the upstream repository is used as the provenance of the defect family and of the Windows behaviour the contract must satisfy (psutil/arch/windows/proc.c: psutil_proc_memory_maps, psutil/arch/windows/mem.c). All code and fixtures in this package are original and were written for this evaluation.
lineage: Public repository defect family (psutil Windows memory_maps: 32-bit truncation of addresses and region sizes, mapped-path buffer handling, \Device\ path translation) -> original wvas contract for auditing a live process' address space -> local differential calibration between the shipped module and the reference payload on real Windows -> container control runs.
pollution_risk: Low. The subject is the Windows virtual memory API: region enumeration through VirtualQueryEx, the STATE/TYPE/PROTECT vocabulary, naming a file-backed region through GetMappedFileNameW and translating the returned device path through QueryDosDeviceW. It does not overlap the other Windows tasks in this batch (wacl, wads, wchunk, wencoding, wfmt, winstall, wpathext, wpipe, wport, wproc, wps, wreg, wreparse, wreserved, wrotate, wscan, wstamp, wsync, wtask, wsparse, wpeimg, wlogseg), which cover ACLs, alternate data streams, chunked containers, encoding, formatting, installers, PATHEXT, pipes, ports, process listings, PowerShell modules, registry, reparse points, reserved device names, log rotation, directory scanning, timestamps, sync, task scheduling, NTFS sparse allocation, PE image layout and log segmentation. No fixture is shared with any other task: the address-space measurements are produced by a target process the graded suite starts at grading time.
authorization: No network access is required to build or grade the task. The image ships a vendored Python embed distribution, a pinned MinGit archive and a local wheelhouse; the graded suite only calls into the Windows kernel already present in the base image.
